# Empirical Result

## CASH: LSTM_DAILY_1 and LSTM_DAILY_2

```{r fig_1, fig.cap="Equity Curves for QQQ Strategies", fig.width=12, fig.height=6, results='hide', results='hide', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.topcaption = TRUE}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

df_ndx <- read.csv('/Users/kamilkashif/Documents/University/Masters Thesis/Master_Thesis_DRL/Results_Daily/QQQ/QQQ_LSTM_DAILY_1/equity_curves_oos.csv')
df_ndx <- subset(df_ndx, select = -Inverse.Volatility)
df_ndx <- subset(df_ndx, select = -Supervised...MVO)
df_ndx <- subset(df_ndx, select = -Equal.Weight.Monthly)
df_rl_1  <- read.csv('/Users/kamilkashif/Documents/University/Masters Thesis/Master_Thesis_DRL/Results_Daily/QQQ/QQQ_LSTM_DAILY_1/rl_equity_oos.csv')
df_rl_2  <- read.csv('/Users/kamilkashif/Documents/University/Masters Thesis/Master_Thesis_DRL/Results_Daily/QQQ/QQQ_LSTM_DAILY_2/rl_equity_oos.csv')

# Convert dates
df_ndx$date <- as.Date(df_ndx$date)
df_rl_1$date  <- as.Date(df_rl_1$date)
df_rl_2$date  <- as.Date(df_rl_2$date) 

# Keep only RL.Agent from df_rl
df_rl_1_plot <- df_rl_1 %>%
  select(date, RL.Agent)
df_rl_2_plot <- df_rl_2 %>%
  select(date, RL.Agent)

# Rename Buy & Hold so it appears nicely in legend
df_ndx_plot <- df_ndx %>%
  rename(`Buy & Hold` = QQQ.Buy.and.Hold)

# Combine both datasets by date
df_plot <- df_ndx_plot %>%
  left_join(df_rl_1_plot, by = "date") %>%
  left_join(df_rl_2_plot, by = "date") %>%
  rename(LSTM_1 = RL.Agent.x, LSTM_2 = RL.Agent.y) # Renaming the joined columns here

# Convert to long format
df_plot_long <- df_plot %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -date, names_to = "Strategy", values_to = "Value")

# Set legend order
df_plot_long$Strategy <- factor(
  df_plot_long$Strategy,
  levels = c(
    "Buy & Hold",
    "Momentum.Top.20.",
    "LSTM_1",
    "LSTM_2"
  )
)

ec_plot <- ggplot(df_plot_long, aes(x = date, y = Value, color = Strategy)) +
  geom_line(size = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Buy & Hold" = "black",
      "Momentum.Top.20." = "darkgreen",
      "LSTM_1" = "darkred",
      "LSTM_2" = "purple"
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  ylab("Equity") +
  xlab("Date") +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(.02, .98),
    legend.justification = c("left", "top"),
    legend.box.just = "left",
    legend.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(colour = "black"),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0, "mm")
  )

ec_plot
```

# Performance Tables

## CASH: LSTM_DAILY_1 and LSTM_DAILY_2

```{r perf_metric_1, results='asis', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# 1. Load Baseline Metrics
perf_metrics_base_model_NDX <- read.csv('/Users/kamilkashif/Documents/University/Masters Thesis/Master_Thesis_DRL/Results_Daily/QQQ/QQQ_LSTM_DAILY_1/performance_metrics_oos.csv')

# Remove unwanted strategies
perf_metrics_base_model_NDX <- perf_metrics_base_model_NDX[
  !(perf_metrics_base_model_NDX$Strategy %in% c("Inverse Volatility", "Supervised + MVO", "Equal-Weight Monthly")),
]

# 2. Load RL Metrics for both agents
perf_metrics_rl1 <- read.csv('/Users/kamilkashif/Documents/University/Masters Thesis/Master_Thesis_DRL/Results_Daily/QQQ/QQQ_LSTM_DAILY_1/rl_performance_metrics.csv')
perf_metrics_rl2 <- read.csv('/Users/kamilkashif/Documents/University/Masters Thesis/Master_Thesis_DRL/Results_Daily/QQQ/QQQ_LSTM_DAILY_2/rl_performance_metrics.csv')

# Prepare RL Agent 1
rl_agent_1 <- perf_metrics_rl1 %>%
  filter(X == "RL Agent") %>%
  mutate(Strategy = "LSTM_1")

# Prepare RL Agent 2
rl_agent_2 <- perf_metrics_rl2 %>%
  filter(X == "RL Agent") %>%
  mutate(Strategy = "LSTM_2")

# Define columns to keep
cols_keep <- c(
  "Strategy",
  "Absolute.Return....",
  "ARC....",
  "ASD....",
  "Max.Drawdown....",
  "MLD..years.",
  "IR1",
  "IR2",
  "Sharpe",
  "Avg.Daily.Turnover...."
)

# Clean baseline table
ndx_table <- perf_metrics_base_model_NDX %>%
  mutate(Strategy = ifelse(Strategy == "QQQ Buy-and-Hold", "Buy & Hold", Strategy)) %>%
  select(all_of(cols_keep))

# Clean RL tables
rl_table <- bind_rows(rl_agent_1, rl_agent_2) %>%
  select(all_of(cols_keep))

# 3. Combine in your EXACT specified order:
final_table <- bind_rows(
  ndx_table %>% filter(Strategy == "Buy & Hold"),        # First: Buy & Hold
  ndx_table %>% filter(Strategy == "Momentum Top-20%"),  # Second: Momentum
  rl_table                                               # Third: LSTMs
)

# 3. Formatting Function
bold_best <- function(x, type = "max", ignore_zeros = FALSE) {
  # Convert to numeric and strip existing LaTeX tags if any
  x_num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("\\\\text.*\\{|\\}", "", as.character(x))))
  
  # Logic to ignore zeros (specifically for ADT)
  search_space <- if(ignore_zeros) x_num[x_num != 0 & !is.na(x_num)] else x_num
  
  # If the search space becomes empty (e.g., all zeros), fall back to original
  if (length(search_space) == 0) search_space <- x_num
  
  best <- if (type == "max") {
    max(search_space, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    min(search_space, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  x_fmt <- format(signif(x_num, 4), scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
  
  # Bold the cell if it matches the 'best' value calculated above
  ifelse(!is.na(x_num) & x_num == best, paste0("\\textbf{", x_fmt, "}"), x_fmt)
}

# Apply bolding to columns
final_table$Absolute.Return.... <- bold_best(final_table$Absolute.Return...., "max")
final_table$ARC.... <- bold_best(final_table$ARC...., "max")
final_table$ASD.... <- bold_best(final_table$ASD...., "min")
final_table$Max.Drawdown.... <- bold_best(final_table$Max.Drawdown...., "min")
final_table$MLD..years. <- bold_best(final_table$MLD..years., "min")
final_table$IR1 <- bold_best(final_table$IR1, "max")
final_table$IR2 <- bold_best(final_table$IR2, "max")
final_table$Sharpe <- bold_best(final_table$Sharpe, "max")
final_table$Avg.Daily.Turnover.... <- bold_best(final_table$Avg.Daily.Turnover...., "min", ignore_zeros = TRUE)

# Escape LaTeX special characters
final_table$Strategy <- gsub("&", "\\\\&", final_table$Strategy)
final_table$Strategy <- gsub("_", "\\\\_", final_table$Strategy)
final_table$Strategy <- gsub("%", "\\\\&", final_table$Strategy)

# 4. Generate Table
kable(
  final_table,
  format = "latex",
  escape = FALSE,
  booktabs = TRUE,
  longtable = FALSE,
  col.names = c(
    "Strategy",
    "AR (\\%)",
    "ARC (\\%)",
    "ASD (\\%)",
    "MD (\\%)",
    "MLD",
    "IR1",
    "IR2",
    "Sharpe",
    "ADT"
  ),
  caption = "Performance Metrics for NASDAQ 100 Strategies",
  align = "c"
) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position", "scale_down")
```
